Welcome to my site! I am currently the Principal Data and AI Solutions Architect at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital. I completed my Master of Public Policy and MSc in Applied Statistics at the University of Oxford as a Rhodes Scholar. My primary professional experiences involve mathematical analysis in healthcare, public health, public policy and law. Ultimately, I am most interested in the power of mathematics to analyze and advocate for public policies that benefit the most marginalized among us.
